title: Bernie-Inspired Benefit Comp Aims To Take America Back
text:
Bernie-Inspired Benefit Comp Aims To Take America Back Hits Home Open Search Dialog Instagram X/Twitter TikTok Releases Bernie-Inspired Benefit Comp Aims To Take America Back 
 October 29, 2026 Open Share Modal On the eve of the midterms, SoundsGood Records announces Take America Back: The Fight Oligarchy Album . Released on CD, vinyl and digital formats Feb. 26, the set—which will not be available on streaming services—benefits nonprofits dedicated to fighting corrupt corporate influences in our democracy. Hmm, who could that be referring to?
 An outgrowth of the Fighting Oligarchy Tour , a series of rallies led by Senator Bernie Sanders , Take America Back features tracks by artists who played the tour, along with allies in the cause. Neil Young , Carole King , Maggie Rogers , Steve Earle , Dirty Projectors , Portugal. The Man and Rufus Wainwright head a lineup that also includes Hüsker Dü , Mt. Joy , Sunny War , Yola , Ratboys and Particle Kid .
 SoundsGood Records co-founder Caleb Wilson said, "The artists on this record have spent their careers refusing to look away and lent their songs to fight for our democracy when we need it most. We purposely made this album something to hold onto, which captures the moment we find ourselves in. A record, in every sense of the word."
